== Trivia ==
* The {{W|Kelpie|kelpie}} is a shapeshifting water spirit from Scottish folklore. They are commonly depicted as equine or humanoid creatures who lure and drag unsuspecting prey into the lakes they inhabit before drowning and devouring them.
* Nightmare: Kelpie appears and behaves identically to the Late Head of Fisalia's Obsession encountered in {{Quest|A Fleeting Night's Dream}}.
